(#Wounded Sykie#
(!begin!
	(closetalk)
	(if (not (flag ^HealedSylkie^))
		(goto [SylkieNotHealed])
		(setchar ^Wounded Sykie^ ^Hitpoints^ 2)
	)
	(end)
)
(!SylkieNotHealed!

	;see the sylkie;
	(if (flag ^SawSylkie^)
		(describe [The Sylkie appears to be suffering from a deep wound in its side.])
		(  (saychar 0 300 300 [The Sylkie appears to be suffering from a deep wound in its side.])
			(sflag ^SawSylkie^ 1)
			(addlocation [Wounded Sylkie] 1581 1049)
		)
	)

	;check to se if party can do anything;
	(if (getchar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^MEDICAL^)
		(if (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^)
			;med and gog;
			(cond (ask [<cast healing spell on the Sylkie>] [<attempt to heal the Sylkie's wounds>] [<ignore the Sylkie>])
				(goto [GOG])
				(goto [MED])
				()
			);cond;
			;just med;
			(if (equals (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) 0)
				(cond (ask [<attempt to heal the Sylkie's wounds>] [<ignore the Sylkie>])
					(goto [MED])
					()
				);cond;
				()
			)
		)
		(if (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^)
			;just gog;
			(cond (ask [<cast healing spell on the Sylkie>] [<ignore the Sylkie>])
				(goto [GOG])
				()
			)
			()
		);if;
	)

	(end)
)

(!GOG!
	(fade 0)
	(fade 1)
	(cond (comp (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) 5)
		(if (equals (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^LEAD^)
			(saychar ^LEAD^ 300 300 [You fail to heal the Sylkie.])
			(saychar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) 300 300 (string [%s fails to heal the Sylkie.] (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^NAME^)))
		)
		(if (equals (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^LEAD^)
			(saychar ^LEAD^ 300 300 [You fail to heal the Sylkie.])
			(saychar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) 300 300 (string [%s fails to heal the Sylkie.] (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^NAME^)))
		)
		(
			(if (equals (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^LEAD^)
				(saychar ^LEAD^ 300 300 [You successfully heal the Sylkie.])
				(saychar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) 300 300 (string [%s successfully heals the Sylkie.] (getchar (getbest ^GIFTS OF GODDESS^) ^NAME^)))
			)
			(goto [HealedSylkie])
		)
	)
)
(!MED!
	(fade 0)
	(fade 1)
	(cond (comp (getchar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^MEDICAL^) 5)
		(if (equals (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^LEAD^)
			(saychar ^LEAD^ 300 300 [You fail to heal the Sylkie.])
			(saychar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) 300 300 (string [%s fails to heal the Sylkie.] (getchar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^NAME^)))
		)
		(if (equals (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^LEAD^)
			(saychar ^LEAD^ 300 300 [You fail to heal the Sylkie.])
			(saychar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) 300 300 (string [%s fails to heal the Sylkie.] (getchar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^NAME^)))
		)
		(
			(if (equals (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^LEAD^)
				(saychar ^LEAD^300 300 [You successfully heal the Sylkie.])
				(saychar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) 300 300 (string [%s successfully heals the Sylkie.] (getchar (getbest ^MEDICAL^) ^NAME^)))
			)
			(goto [HealedSylkie])
		)
	)
)
(!HealedSylkie!
	(sflag ^HealedSylkie^ 1)
	(move ^Wounded Sykie^ 1570 1050)

		(
			(update ^Wounded Sykie^)
			(drawscreen)
		)
	)

			()

		()

				(sflag ^Wager^ 20)
			)
			(  (flagm ^PartyDrachs^ 20)
				(sflag ^Wager^ 20)
			)
		)
		(cond (comp (flag ^PartyDrachs^) 50)
			(  (say [Get out of here before I call the guards.])
				(ask [<done>])
				(end)
			)
			(  (flagm ^PartyDrachs^ 50)
				(sflag ^Wager^ 50)

		(end)

		()

	(goto [bet])
